QUOTE: In `response_generator.cpp:410-420`, the observer thread writes a non-atomic `cancel_int`. The pollers in `inference_c_api.cpp` and `interface_factory.cpp` read it through an `int*`. That is a data race under the C++ memory model... The fix is to make the cancel word an `std::atomic<int>`

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer treats the observer thread and plain int as a data-race bug. It never says the thread exists to bridge an atomic into a plain int because the C ABI cannot carry an atomic.
